title: Take-Two Reports Fiscal Q2 Results, Net Bookings $1.60 Billion
summary: Take-Two reported fiscal Q2 2027 Net Bookings of $1.60 billion, down 18%, and kept its fiscal 2027 Net Bookings outlook at $8.0 to $8.2 billion.
body_markdown:
Net Bookings, which the company calls its operational metric, decreased 18% to $1.60 billion from $1.96 billion. Net Bookings from recurrent consumer spending, which includes virtual currency, add-on content and in-game purchases, decreased 9% and accounted for 81% of the total. The release named NBA 2K, the Grand Theft Auto series, Toon Blast, Match Factory! and Empires & Puzzles among the largest contributors.


For the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, Take-Two updated its outlook to GAAP net revenue of $7,980 million to $8,180 million and diluted net income per share of $0.57 to $0.75, while keeping Net Bookings at $8.0 to $8.2 billion. For the fiscal third quarter ending December 31, 2026, it expects Net Bookings of $3,350 million to $3,500 million and diluted net income per share of $1.30 to $1.44.


## Why It Matters for TTWO


The company tied its outlook to Grand Theft Auto VI, which its release lists for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on Thursday, November 19, 2026. Chairman and CEO Strauss Zelnick said: "The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company."
